title: AstroML VariableStarClassification

stats.done_summary: Completed variable vs non-variable classification using symbol_series features. Implemented TF–IDF character n-gram + logistic regression with validation-tuned hyperparameters, computed constant-probability baselines, generated EDA and evaluation figures (ROC/PR, calibration, confusion, score distributions, length/missingness, top n-grams), saved artifacts to outputs/, and rendered a publication-style report at report/report.md with embedded PNG figures.
